strategies.name: ORB
strategies.signal_conditions: Candle body closes outside opening range with volume > volume SMA and trend aligned with EMA20 slope.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Inside opening range, breakout volume < average, flat EMA slope, overextended from range, counter-trend EMA.

strategies.name: TREND_FOLLOWING
strategies.signal_conditions: 15m trend established (EMA20 > EMA50, ADX > 20), 5m pullback to EMA20 with rejection wick, confirmed by volume expansion.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Choppy ADX (<20), flat EMA slope, price stretched >2.5 ATR from 5m EMA20 (overextended), counter-trend pullback.

strategies.name: VWAP_EMA
strategies.signal_conditions: Price positioned above/below VWAP, aligned with EMA20, test/bounce of VWAP or EMA20 confirmed by volume and EMA slope.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Price cross conflicting VWAP, flat slope, overextended (>2.0 ATR from EMA20), insufficient volume.

strategies.name: BB_RSI_MEAN_REVERSION
strategies.signal_conditions: Price touches/pierces outer Bollinger Band, RSI oversold (<30) for LONG or overbought (>70) for SHORT, followed by reversal candle closing back inside band.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Forbidden in trending market regime, RSI not extreme, Bollinger Band expansion (breakout rather than reversion).

strategies.name: ATR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT
strategies.signal_conditions: Volatility compression detected (current ATR < 0.7 * ATR MA), followed by expansion breakout candle closing outside consolidation range with volume.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Wick-only breakout without body close outside range, low volume, lack of prior compression.

strategies.name: LIQUIDITY_SWEEP
strategies.signal_conditions: False breakout beyond prior swing high/low with long rejection wick and close back inside range, accompanied by volume spike.
strategies.rejection_conditions: Clean breakout closing beyond swing level without rejection, lack of volume spike, insufficient wick ratio.

arbitration_engine.regime_filtering: Blocks trending strategies in ranging regimes; blocks mean reversion in trending regimes; blocks all strategies in UNCERTAIN regimes or during system WARMING_UP.
